bounds: S is sum of all observed keyed stress cells; k is total unobserved cells among 5*N target cells. Lower=(S+k)/(5*N), upper=(S+5*k)/(5*N). Support bounds, not confidence intervals.
example_selection: lexicographically first complete stress record with raw st4 different from 3
groups: part_time=0 or 1 from invitation frame; response/complete counts and proportions
inference_scope: observed subset description and finite-roster support bounds; no MAR model, imputation, sampling CI or World reveal
patterns: five bits in st1..st5 order, 1=observed; all invitees represented
person_bounds: use complete-person keyed total and replace every incomplete person by five cells at lower/upper support; diagnostic comparison only
score: mean of all five keyed responses; incomplete scores stay blank
serialization: 17 significant digits for numerical outputs; original IDs and five-bit strings exact
